resources.string: Meter started — base %1$s XMR, %2$s XMR per minute. The bill at the end shows the minutes.
They connected but the terms did not send: %1$s
A rate typed in %1$s is locked to XMR when the ride starts — the figure the rider agrees to is the figure they are billed.
Set a per-minute rate to open the pickup code.
The rider scans or taps. The rate lands in the conversation and the meter starts by itself.
The bill shows the minutes and the rate. The receipt goes to them by itself when the fare lands — even after they have walked away.
The meter stops and no bill is sent. The minutes counted so far are discarded and cannot be recovered.
